title: centaurea pectinata var. genuina
intro: Centaurea pectinata var. genuina, commonly known as prickly knapweed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and exhibiting immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea pectinata var. genuina include sesquiterpene lactones, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
